leadText: Pokémon Adventures: The S.S. Ann Adventure is the twenty-fourth monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Mato. It contains chapters fourteen, fifteen, and sixteen of the . The chapters originally released in this book were later rereleased as part of . As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.
